title: Slappy Blackhead’s Way Cool Journey Through Time
description: With his bicycle and some microwaved uranium he got from science class, Slappy Blackhead travels back in time to change history.
quote: Dude, would Slappy Blackhead steer you wrong?
altHero: Slappy Blackhead, a teen on a bicycle with an alarm clock attached
alt1: Slappy’s friend, also with a bike helmet on
alt2: the friend looking at a plate of uranium in the microwave
alt3: glowing uranium being scooped into the alarm clock on the bike
